meta.title: Blackridge Coal Mine - Pit to Port
meta.description: Full coal mining process flow: mine operations (exploration, drilling & blasting, overburden removal, coal extraction, loading, hauling), CHPP processing plant (crushing, conveying, screening, dense-media washing, dewatering, stockyard) and downstream logistics (rail load-out, dispatch, shiploading, shipping, end-use customer).
meta.prompt: Create a digital twin of the coal mining process flow (upstream mine operations, processing plant, downstream logistics & shipping).
